exposure: Maternal serum PAPP-A multiple of medians (MoM) levels (<=0.40 MoM, <=0.35 MoM, <=0.30 MoM)
cohort: The study included 23,482 women with singleton pregnancies who participated in first trimester combined screening for chromosomal abnormalities.
finding: PAPP-A <=0.40 MoM should be considered as a primary screening cut-off for adverse pregnancy outcomes, as approximately 23% will develop either SGA, HDP, or PTB, and it appears to be the best cut-off to screen for SGA.
